description: Header file defining the ProtectedMemoryAllocator class, which manages a simple memory allocation pool with protection features, including methods for allocation, protection, and querying memory status.

classes.name: ProtectedMemoryAllocator
classes.description: A class providing a simple memory allocator with protection capabilities, allowing allocation within a fixed pool, and toggling between read-only and read/write states.

methods.name: ProtectedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Constructor initializing the allocator with a specified pool size.

methods.name: ~ProtectedMemoryAllocator
methods.description: Destructor for cleaning up the allocator.

methods.name: Allocate
methods.description: Allocates a block of memory of specified size within the pool.

methods.name: GetBaseAddress
methods.description: Returns the base address of the memory pool.

methods.name: GetTotalSize
methods.description: Returns the total size of the memory pool.

methods.name: GetAllocatedSize
methods.description: Returns the total allocated bytes within the pool.

methods.name: GetFreeSize
methods.description: Returns the remaining free bytes available for allocation.

methods.name: Protect
methods.description: Sets the entire memory pool to read-only.

methods.name: Unprotect
methods.description: Sets the entire memory pool to read/write.
